stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

on the last line of your reply:

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt cap is reached, and
reaching the cap is charged the full cap. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

# Add an 8-connected rasterized outline among the three 8 markers to the prior candidate.
# Bresenham segments in (row,col) coords.
def line(a,b):
 r0,c0=a; r1,c1=b
 pts=[]
 dx=abs(c1-c0); sx=1 if c0<c1 else -1
 dy=-abs(r1-r0); sy=1 if r0<r1 else -1
 err=dx+dy
 while True:
  pts.append((r0,c0))
  if (r0,c0)==(r1,c1): break
  e2=2*err
  if e2>=dy: err+=dy; c0+=sx
  if e2<=dx: err+=dx; r0+=sy
 return pts
# recreate previous grid from points and collinear strokes
G=[[0]*21 for _ in range(21)]
for col,arr in pts.items():
 for r,c in arr:G[r][c]=col
for col,arr in pts.items():
 for i,(r1,c1) in enumerate(arr):
  for r2,c2 in arr[i+1:]:
   dr,dc=r2-r1,c2-c1
   if dr==0 or dc==0 or abs(dr)==abs(dc):
    sr=0 if dr==0 else (1 if dr>0 else -1); sc=0 if dc==0 else (1 if dc>0 else -1)
    for k in range(max(abs(dr),abs(dc))+1):G[r1+sr*k][c1+sc*k]=col
for a,b in zip([(13,10),(15,16),(17,13)],[(15,16),(17,13),(13,10)]):
 for r,c in line(a,b):G[r][c]=8
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,row)) for row in G))
